All theme-aware computed colours read AppDependencies.current.app.settingsManager.settings (colorTheme, appearanceTheme) at call time; SwiftUI re-renders only when an observing view re-evaluates.

flags.text: Every theme-aware colour reaches into the global AppDependencies.current.app.settingsManager singleton instead of the SwiftUI environment, so colour depends on hidden global state and views re-colour only when something else triggers a re-render.

The night's RMSSDCategory by the rule 'What This Means' (AnalysisSummaryGenerator.hrvCategory) uses: personalCategory(hrv/baseline) with a positive baseline, else AgeAdjustedHRV.interpret with the user's age and sex from settings (absolute bands when no age).

units.does: HRV word: hrvCategory's localizedLabel (Excellent/Good/Fair/Reduced/Low), so the label matches 'What This Means' with or without a baseline.
HRV colour of the hrvCategory tier: excellent sage, good softGold, fair terracotta, reduced/low dustyRose.
Text shade of the hrvCategory tier: excellent sageText, good softGoldText, fair terracottaText, reduced/low dustyRoseText.
Colour for a data-source key: composite softGold, internal sage, streaming primary, else textSecondary.
Localized label for a data-source key: 'Streamed + Strap', 'Strap', 'Streamed', else the raw key capitalized (unlocalized).

Neutral LF/HF colour: textTertiary when ratio nil, else textPrimary.

Filled button: headline label in labelColor when enabled (white where white clears 4.5:1 on the fill, else black) and white when disabled, padding, rounded fill in `color` (disabled: textTertiary@35%), coloured shadow when enabled, 0.7 opacity when disabled, 0.97 press scale when enabled.
White when whiteClearsContrast on the fill colour resolved in the current environment, else black.
Whether white text on the resolved fill reaches 4.5:1: WCAG relative luminance from the linearized sRGB channels, contrast 1.05/(L+0.05).
sRGB channel to linear: c/12.92 at or below 0.04045, else ((c+0.055)/1.055)^2.4.
Outlined secondary button: primary-coloured label (textTertiary disabled), 1.5pt primary stroke (0.3/0.15 opacity) over cardBackground, disabled opacity 0.7, press scale 0.97.
